name: ciphermap_scan_all
description: Run a 100% local, zero-egress PQC + Immunity security scan across the confined workspace or a relative file/subdirectory, returning structured findings and required safe guardrail primitives.

include_tests.description: Include test files in scan results (defaults to false).

target_path.description: Optional relative file or directory path within the workspace to scan.

workspace.description: Optional workspace directory (must reside within the server's confined root).

annotations.title: Scan Workspace for PQC & Immunity Findings

name: ciphermap_inspect_rule
description: Inspect the authoritative NIST FIPS / CWE contract, safe guardrail primitives, checklist, and before/after remediation examples for any PQC or Immunity rule ID.

language.description: Optional target language (e.g. go, typescript, python, rust, java) for language-bound guardrail primitives.

rule_id.description: CipherMap rule identifier (e.g. IMM-SQLI-001, IMM-BOUND-001, PQC-GO-AST-002, PQC-001).

annotations.title: Inspect NIST FIPS / CWE Rule Contract

name: ciphermap_verify_candidate_fix
description: Stage candidate_content ONLY inside an ephemeral temporary sandbox copy (never mutating the live workspace) and verify: (1) target rule_id finding is eliminated with zero new findings introduced, and (2) balanced syntax + confined offline compiler/test gates pass, returning structured counterexamples on failure.

candidate_content.description: Complete proposed file contents to verify inside the ephemeral referee sandbox.

file_path.description: Relative path to the target source file within the workspace.

rule_id.description: Target CipherMap rule ID that the candidate fix must eliminate.

workspace.description: Optional workspace directory within the server's confined root.

annotations.title: Verify Candidate Patch in Ephemeral Sandbox

name: ciphermap_verify_workspace_clean
description: Verify that the confined workspace has zero remaining PQC or Immunity findings and cryptographically verify any dual-signed Ed25519 + NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 ProofBundle.

include_tests.description: Include test files when verifying workspace cleanliness (defaults to false).

proof_bundle_path.description: Optional relative path to immunity-proof-bundle-v1.json within the workspace.

workspace.description: Optional workspace directory within the server's confined root.

annotations.title: Verify Zero Findings & Dual PQC ProofBundle

name: ciphermap_verify_dependencies
description: Firewall proposed cryptographic and post-quantum dependencies against slopsquatting/typosquatting (Damerau-Levenshtein d_OSA <= 2), hallucinated PQC stems, and KyberSlash-vulnerable TIMING_UNSAFE_DEV_ONLY pure-script fallbacks.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem (go, npm, pypi, cargo, maven, nuget).

fips_required.description: Require hardware/C constant-time FIPS 140-3 aligned implementations (defaults to false).

packages.description: Proposed package coordinates to audit before installation.

name: ciphermap_recommend_pqc_sdk
description: Recommend audited, constant-time NIST FIPS 203/204/205 (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, Hybrid-TLS) SDKs and import idioms for a target language.

fips_required.description: Filter to FIPS 140-3 / constant-time native modules only.

language.description: Target language or ecosystem (go, typescript, python, rust, java, csharp).

primitive.description: Target cryptographic primitive (e.g. ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, Hybrid-TLS).

name: ciphermap_generate_cbom
description: Generate and schema-validate a CycloneDX 1.7 (or 1.6) Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) for the confined workspace, returning asset breakdowns, quantum-readiness counts, and optional confined workspace file output.

include_tests.description: Include test files in cryptographic discovery (defaults to false).

output_path.description: Optional workspace-relative path to write the validated CycloneDX CBOM JSON.

target_path.description: Optional workspace-relative subdirectory or file to scan.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path (must resolve to the server workspace root).

name: ciphermap_generate_pqc_wrapper
description: Generate a zero-code NIST FIPS 203/204/205 post-quantum compensating control bundle (envoy, nginx, k8s-sidecar, ipsec, cert-manager, or cnsa-2.0) plus preflight verification script for legacy/COTS/infrastructure findings.

include_tests.description: Include test files in scan (defaults to false).

target_path.description: Optional workspace-relative subdirectory or file to scan.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path (must resolve to the server workspace root).

name: ciphermap_compliance_crosswalk
description: Evaluate the confined workspace against 16 global statutory cryptographic mandates (CNSA 2.0, NIST IR 8547, OMB M-26-15, EU DORA, PCI DSS 4.0.1, FedRAMP Rev.5, HIPAA, etc.) and compute an optimal hypergraph hitting-set remediation schedule.

include_tests.description: Include test files in scan (defaults to false).

target_path.description: Optional workspace-relative subdirectory or file to scan.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path (must resolve to the server workspace root).

name: ciphermap_extinguish_immunity
description: Synthesize polyglot AST/AIConfig codemods and verify every candidate fix through CipherMap's 4-Gate Vericoding pipeline (Gate 1 lexical/AST + rescan dominance, Gate 2 pre-triggered/post-killed witness execution, Gate 3 native compiler/test + ddmin batch salvage, Gate 4 zero new findings). Defaults to dry-run preview (apply=false); pass apply=true to persist verified fixes.

apply.description: Persist verified patches to workspace files (defaults to false for zero-mutation dry-run preview).

enable_race.description: Enable concurrency/race detectors in Gate 3 native tests (defaults to false).

helper_strategy.description: Helper emission strategy ('auto', 'inline', or 'shared'). Defaults to 'auto'.

include_tests.description: Include test files in Immunity extinguish (defaults to false).

proof_out_path.description: Optional workspace-relative path to write the dual Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65 ProofBundle JSON.

rule_filter.description: Optional Immunity RuleIDs to restrict extinguish to (e.g. ['IMM-SQLI-001', 'IMM-SSRF-001']).

workspace.description: Optional workspace directory within the server's confined root.

name: ciphermap_check_baseline_health
description: Run strictly read-only T0 compiler/syntax baseline probes (with Git tree-hash caching) across workspace modules, returning mathematical fault attributions (CUSTOMER_PREEXISTING_FAILURE vs. ENV_DEPENDENCY_BLOCKER) and unmodified culprit files/packages so AI agents never waste tokens trying to fix pre-broken customer builds.

workspace.description: Optional workspace directory within the server's confined root.

annotations.title: Check T0 Compiler & Syntax Baseline Health
